(Verka) has released the Milkfed Verka Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 notification for 172 Deputy Manager vacancies across 15 disciplines, including Marketing, Finance & Accounts, Human Resources, Production, Quality Assurance, Engineering, Animal Husbandry, and more. This probation pay does not include other allowances admissible to regular employees, except travelling allowance and mobile allowance. On successful completion of probation and regularization, the candidate will be allowed the regular pay scale of the post along with all admissible allowances as per Milkfed's service rules.

important_instructions: Punjabi up to Matric standard is compulsory for direct recruitment Acceptance of application and allotment of roll number does not guarantee eligibility; document scrutiny happens after the written test No travelling allowance is admissible for appearing in the written test, counselling, or any other stage All documents must be self-attested and submitted with a signed affidavit at the document verification stage A common written examination will be held for Deputy Manager (Procurement), Deputy Manager (Production), and Deputy Manager (Quality Assurance), though separate merit lists will be prepared for each post Result and all recruitment-related information will be published only on the Milkfed website; no separate correspondence will be made Milkfed reserves the right to modify or withdraw the number of posts or the recruitment notice without assigning any reason Candidates working in Government/Semi-Government/Cooperative organizations must submit a No Objection Certificate and get relieved before joining Appointment is subject to character/antecedent verification, medical fitness, and police verification In case of any application-related problem, candidates may email: [email protected]

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Milkfed Verka Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 172 vacancies across 15 Deputy Manager disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. When does the online application for Milkfed Verka Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 start?
faq.answer: Online registration starts on 05.08.2026 after 12 noon.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Milkfed Verka Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration is 25.08.2026 up to 11.59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Milkfed Verka Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- for UR/BC/ESM/Sports categories and Rs. 600/- for SC, EWS, and PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Milkfed Verka Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 45 years of age as on 01.07.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Milkfed Verka Deputy Manager posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a written test (100 MCQs, 80% weightage) and marks for relevant work experience (maximum 20 marks, 20% weightage).

faq.question: Q7. Where will the written test for Milkfed Verka Deputy Manager Recruitment be conducted?
faq.answer: The written test will be conducted only in Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q8. What is the minimum qualifying mark in the Milkfed Verka written test?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifying mark is 40% for Unreserved category candidates and 35% for all reserved category candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary during the probation period for Milkfed Verka Deputy Manager posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a minimum basic pay of Rs. 56,100/- per month during the 2-year probation period, along with travelling and mobile allowance only.

faq.answer: Yes, qualification of Punjabi up to Matric standard is compulsory for direct recruitment.
